candidate_072.name: physics-informed data-fidelity admission gate before scientific acquisition scoring
candidate_072.mechanism_hypothesis: Autonomous scientific acquisition should treat measurement fidelity/admissibility as a separate precondition rather than allowing uncertainty, novelty, diversity, or discovery scores to compete directly with obviously low-quality measurements. First predict or measure a modality-specific physical quality score and exclude candidates below an admissibility threshold; only then rank the surviving candidates for discovery/generalization value. This prevents sensor noise or corrupted observations from masquerading as epistemic uncertainty and consuming the acquisition budget.

primary_evidence.source: Jawad Chowdhury et al., Quality-controlled active learning via Gaussian processes for robust structure-property learning in autonomous microscopy, npj Computational Materials, published 2026-08-21, DOI 10.1038/s41524-026-02248-x.
primary_evidence.design: PbTiO3 band-excitation piezoresponse spectroscopy structure-property learning with spatially localized spectral degradation. ActiveQC combines curiosity/error, diversity and representativeness scoring with a Simple Harmonic Oscillator R^2 quality model that gates low-fidelity spectra. Benchmark comparisons use the same seed set and 30 random trials for Im2Spec and Spec2Im. The framework was also deployed on a separate PbTiO3 thin-film sample in real-time AFM acquisition, where no full ground truth was available.
primary_evidence.quantitative_result: At acquisition step 25 on Im2Spec, test MSE was 0.0307 +/- 0.0006 for ActiveQC versus 0.0355 +/- 0.0005 Random, 0.0394 +/- 0.0009 standard Active and 0.0365 +/- 0.0006 ActiveMT: approximately 13.5%, 22.1% and 15.9% lower respectively. On Spec2Im, step-25 MSE was 0.0208 +/- 0.0004 versus 0.0256 +/- 0.0003 Random, 0.0298 +/- 0.0006 Active and 0.0311 +/- 0.0005 ActiveMT: approximately 18.8%, 30.2% and 33.1% lower. The paper reports p < 0.05 Welch t-tests against all baselines over the final acquisition rounds.
primary_evidence.mechanistic_observation: Standard curiosity-driven acquisition can assign high utility to corrupted/noisy regions because the base model makes larger errors there. ActiveQC predicts measurement fidelity separately and rejects low-SHO-R^2 candidates before they enter training/acquisition, so high error is not automatically interpreted as useful scientific uncertainty.
primary_evidence.real_time_boundary: Real-time AFM deployment on three ActiveQC and three Random regions of a separate sample qualitatively concentrated measurements near informative domain walls and avoided weak/degraded switching responses, but the authors explicitly lacked full ground truth there, so this part is practical feasibility evidence rather than a quantitative superiority estimate.
primary_evidence.threshold_boundary: The benchmark used a fixed quality threshold tau=0.30 and fixed acquisition mixture weights alpha=0.90, beta=gamma=0.05. In real-time deployment tau was selected empirically by a domain expert at each stage. Therefore the study does not demonstrate autonomous threshold adaptation or dynamic discovery-versus-coverage lane allocation.
primary_evidence.interpretation: This supplies recent peer-reviewed science-domain evidence that acquisition utility needs a separate data-fidelity/admissibility axis. It complements candidate_071: discovery and generalization should stay separate objectives, but both can be corrupted if low-fidelity measurements are allowed to enter the candidate pool merely because they look uncertain.
primary_evidence.limits: The physical gate is specific to BEPS/SHO fit quality and localized spectral degradation. The live experiment is qualitative. No matched ablation isolates automatic threshold selection, and no evidence here proves a universal quality metric across scientific modalities.

candidate_072.relation_to_existing: candidate_071 separated discovery yield from generalization/model-learning; candidate_051 required surrogate admissibility before trusting a scientific model. candidate_072 adds a third acquisition-control layer: measurement/data admissibility should precede both discovery and generalization scoring, because low-quality observations can masquerade as high uncertainty.
